Community language server for Kotlin (fwcd). It runs on the JVM and reads Gradle projects to analyze code.

• Code completion
• Errors and warnings (diagnostics)
• Hover info and signature help
• Go to definition, find references
• Document symbols (outline)
• Requires openjdk-17\n• Startup and first analysis are slow; memory use is high on large projects\n• Refactoring support (e.g. rename) is limited compared to IDE plugins
The Java language server of the Eclipse project (JDT Language Server). It uses the Eclipse Java compiler and understands Maven and Gradle projects.

• Code completion and organize imports
• Diagnostics
• Navigation: definition, references, implementations
• Refactoring: rename, extract method and other code actions
• Formatting
• Requires openjdk-17 and python (launch script)\n• The first start indexes the workspace and is slow\n• High memory use; the server may be killed on low-end devices
Language server for C and C++ from the LLVM project. It uses the Clang compiler and is provided as a Termux package (clang).

• Completion, hover, signature help
• Diagnostics with fix-its
• Definition, references, rename
• Formatting via clang-format
• Needs a compile_commands.json or compile_flags.txt for accurate results\n• Installation and updates go through the Termux package, not the app\n• Large projects need time to build the index
Static type checker and language server for Python from Microsoft. It runs on Node.js and is installed through npm.

• Type checking and diagnostics
• Completion, hover, signature help
• Definition, references, rename
• Auto-import
• Requires nodejs\n• No code formatting (use a separate tool)\n• Results depend on the detected Python interpreter and installed packages
The official language server for Rust. It is provided as a Termux package and analyzes Cargo projects.

• Completion, hover, inlay hints
• Diagnostics (also via cargo check)
• Definition, references, rename
• Code actions and refactorings
• Needs a Cargo project\n• High memory and CPU use; the first indexing is slow\n• Installation and updates go through the Termux package
Collection of the language servers extracted from VS Code for HTML, CSS and JSON. They run on Node.js.

• Completion and hover for HTML, CSS/SCSS/LESS and JSON
• Validation
• Formatting
• Document symbols
• Requires nodejs\n• JSON schemas that must be fetched from the network are missing offline\n• No framework-specific support (e.g. Vue or Angular)
XML language server from the Eclipse LemMinX project. It runs as a Java archive.

• Completion and hover based on XSD and DTD
• Validation
• Formatting
• Document symbols and folding
• Requires openjdk-17\n• Schemas that must be fetched from the network are missing offline\n• No special knowledge of Android resource XML
YAML language server from Red Hat. It runs on Node.js and validates against JSON schemas.

• Completion and hover based on JSON schemas
• Validation and diagnostics
• Formatting
• Document symbols
• Requires nodejs\n• Schemas from the network (e.g. SchemaStore) are missing offline\n• Schema mapping must be configured per project
TOML toolkit with a language server. It is provided as a Termux package (taplo).

• Validation and diagnostics
• Formatting
• Completion and hover with schemas
• Document symbols
• Schemas from the network are missing offline\n• Installation and updates go through the Termux package
Language server for shell and Bash scripts. It runs on Node.js and optionally uses shellcheck.

• Completion, hover, definition
• References and rename within the scripts
• Diagnostics via shellcheck (if installed)
• Document symbols
• Requires nodejs\n• Without shellcheck there are no lint diagnostics\n• Analysis only knows what is in the scripts themselves, not installed commands
